name: Dial
idea: A single hand turns a quiet wheel, making prediction and adjustment the defining gesture.

name: Taking Form
idea: Three equal-weight lines close into a figure, expressing an idea becoming a concrete model.

name: Reveal
idea: One solid half-disc suggests the visible half of an idea whose hidden structure is waiting to be revealed.

name: Reflection
idea: Two mirrored arcs frame the same empty space, suggesting one form understood through another.

name: Lens
idea: Two opposing arcs become one solid lens, a minimal metaphor for seeing an idea through a model.

name: Hinge
idea: Two joined lines describe a movable angle, reducing interactive learning to one clear change in geometry.

name: Becoming
idea: An unfinished circular sweep captures a line on its way to becoming a complete form.

name: Control
idea: A single circular control interrupts a straight track, making hands-on exploration the entire symbol.
